en: Colorized divided-back postcard with two views of a restaurant. The top shows the exterior of a two‑story corner building bearing signage including 'RESTAURATION'; the caption beneath reads 'Grand-Restaurant Gambrinus, Marburg a. Dr.' The lower image shows the interior dining hall with white‑clothed tables and chandeliers. The reverse is blank for address/message with a circular library stamp and small printer numbers.
